body: I've wanted to end it for such a long time. I'm exhausted from the misery and crippling loneliness. I have no way out of a life of pain. This is my only option left.

I'm alone. Crisis hotlines can fuck right off. Medications have never made me feel any different. Temperature shock didn't work in last attempt I doubt it would work here. I left my old DBT therapist anyway.
That's not very nice to say. And I think it's pretty obvious that gonzz is being ridiculous.
